label: Hudson FST per window (pairwise)
description: Per-window Hudson FST between two sample sets. Columns: chrom, start_bp, end_bp, n_snps, fst.

label: Nucleotide diversity per window
description: Per-window theta_pi for a single sample set. Columns: chrom, start_bp, end_bp, n_snps, theta_pi.

label: dXY per window
description: Per-window absolute divergence between two sample sets. Columns: chrom, start_bp, end_bp, n_snps, dxy.

label: Tajima's D per window
description: Per-window Tajima's D for a single sample set. Columns: chrom, start_bp, end_bp, n_snps, tajimas_d.

label: Inversion-groupwise popstats result (chain output)
description: Per-candidate per-karyotype-group popstats. Output of the inversion_groupwise_popstats chain. Columns: candidate_id, group (homA|het|homB), stat_name, value, n_samples.

label: Per-regime Mendelian annotation
description: Per-regime Method A (trio contradiction) + Method B (per-family chi-sq goodness-of-fit). Columns: regime_id, support_status, family_id, segregation_status, effect_direction, chi2, p_value.

label: Inverse pedigree from regimes
description: Per-sample-pair relatedness verdict from regime co-membership. Columns: sample_a, sample_b, same_class_frac, n_called, by_class, verdict.

label: MSMC2 Ne curve per founder-like group
description: SPEC ONLY. Per-group MSMC2 demographic history. Columns: group, t_generations, ne, ne_lower, ne_upper, mutation_rate, generation_time_y, msmc_version, genome_mask.
